text:
Kai: Hi all, Im landing my first change to routing (branch feat/kai/quick-route). CI is unhappy with pre-commit and theres a failing type check. Also unsure about commit message format and who to ask to review/merge. Any quick first-week PR tips? :wave:

devex-bot: Welcome! Quickstart PR checklist available: https://redwood.dev/devex/pr-checklist. Local commands that help: `./scripts/setup`, `pre-commit run --all-files`, and `poetry run pytest path/to/test`.

Olivia: Welcome aboard! Branching rules: `feat/` or `fix/` prefix, then ticket or short description, optionally your initials. Examples: `feat/1234-add-fallthrough` or `feat/kai/quick-route`. Commit messages should follow Conventional Commits: `feat(runtime): add route fallback` or `fix(api): handle null header`. Keep PRs focused (<300 LOC). For bigger changes include a short design note in the PR body.

Jess: For reviewers, mention one person from CODEOWNERS plus one peer. If you touch infra or runtime, ping @Mira; UI-related changes ping @Jess. If unsure, tag @Olivia for triage.

Mira: Lint/type failures are the usual suspects. Run locally before pushing:
```
poetry install
poetry run ruff check .
poetry run ruff --fix .
poetry run black .
poetry run mypy src/
```
If mypy complains about TypedDict shapes, it's often missing Optional or extra keys. Paste the error here or DM me and we can pair for 15 minutes.

Kai: Thanks! One more: do we squash on merge? How many approvals do we need?

Olivia: We prefer "Squash and merge" for feature branches to keep history tidy. Protection rules: 1 approval + green CI for most areas. Critical paths (infra/, eng-runtime/) require 2 approvals and passing integration tests. CODEOWNERS approvals are enforced automatically.

Jess: Add a manual test checklist in the PR when behavior changes: quick steps, expected outcome, and any env vars needed. Also link the ticket number in the title (e.g., "1234: routing fallback").

ci-bot: CI | Build #4410 - Lint failed (ruff) on 2 files. See logs: https://ci.redwood/build/4410

Mira: If you paste the two ruff errors I can point to exact fixes. `ruff --fix` usually resolves formatting; types sometimes need annotations.

Kai: I ran `ruff --fix` and fixed formatting; one mypy TypedDict error remains. I'll DM Mira for a quick pairing session. Really appreciate the rapid help :thumbsup:

devex-bot: If you want a 15-min walk-through, book a 1:1 via calendars.redwood/team/devex and pick "PR pairing" slot.
